judgment: Positive extent=body and negative whole-English-body records retain the same canonical source target, appointed occurrence, component and denominator. Repeated names, forms, cycles and borrowers do not acquire another body's scope from a shared citation.

Only English acquires literal-body scope. Latin remains Bible reconstruction, and the separate Scripture component keeps its original meaning. Unscoped or non-English positive rows do not establish body coverage.

Both the checker and producer require the closed exact admission_id path/hash dispatcher. The production source-admission map and target-recension edge map are both empty; no actual positive Scripture body is authorized.

The pinned packet must bind exact English and target identity, its complete separately verified target witness, independently held public-domain Latin passages, source-record ancestors, payload hashes and a whole-body arrangement/variant assessment. A citation, method label or data-row assertion cannot register an admission.

A parent is validated against its own source calendar. Exact child exclusions run before residual inherited bodies are considered. Matching citations or English never establish child agreement: a remaining body requires an independently closed child packet, which is revalidated against child evidence.

Prior source_latin study-binding protections remain operational. The coverage change is limited to unit(); every other _missal_coverage AST node is exact to the declared base, including the separately owned bounded-form accounting.
